game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Lake, a lake of glacier melt: the summit pilot must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Frequency Bazaar: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Lake: a lake of glacier melt
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Lake, repeat each round: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary. Each round, frost wyrms strike the basecamp tent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the tally value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the basecamp tent from frost wyrms in Glacier Lake: keep the tally meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: tally drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Frequency Bazaar
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Frequency Bazaar' (Week 8 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Glacier Lake'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tally changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Lake.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while tally > 0.
